_comment: The background pictures that ship with Golf Tycoon. MenuBackdrop paints one of these behind every out-of-game screen. A mod adds its own by declaring content.menu_backdrops in its mod.json; an id that already exists here is patched, a new id is namespaced to the mod. `image` is relative to the catalogue file's folder unless it starts with res:// or user://. `tint` is multiplied over the picture (ffffff leaves it untouched). `scrim` sets how dark the top and bottom bands are, so headings stay readable on a bright picture. `seasons` and `themes` are what Auto looks at: a picture tagged for the current season, or for the theme of the course being played, is preferred. Leave a picture's themes empty when the season should decide instead.

clubhouse.name: Clubhouse
clubhouse.description: The classic view: a modern clubhouse above the water, the city on the horizon and a bright daylight sky.

golden_hour.description: The same clubhouse at sunset - a warm sky, long shadows and every window lit.
